doc.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022

title: Did the turbulence of the 60s shape the music; the level of the giants
summary: Weiss says experience shows in the tone, but also that the 60s musicians were driven by the high level around them, such as Lee Morgan and Coltrane in New York.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: I’m fascinated by the connections between jazz and what’s going on in society. Do you feel that those musicians that were young men in the 60s, do you have a sense that their music was significantly affected by the turbulence of the 60s?

I think the old adage is — and I forgot it. Something about you can’t play it unless you’ve lived it or something like that. Or you know if you have an experience it can’t come out of your horn. I’m still floored by that sometimes. We can be just sitting at a rehearsal and getting warmed up and Billy Harper will take the horn out of his case and go like [woosh] and I can hear fifty years in the tone. I can hear that. I can’t hear that with just anybody you know. So there’s something, but it’s more than that. I mean that is part of it you know, clearly turbulent times stir something up in you and it comes out in your music. But also, a lot of it is the level those guys functioned at, and the level of the people around them you know. I think I mean I’m generalizing but I think this goes to almost everybody I’ve dealt with from that era. They were always scared of somebody. There was somebody walking the earth — I mean Freddie Hubbard always told me about Lee Morgan. You know? And how determined — they all had a determination (a) maybe ‘cause the stakes were higher I mean I can’t speak to that stuff well but I mean if music like sports is a way out of something and everybody else around you is really good, you know if you’re walking into New York and John Coltrane’s there already what are you going to do? You know? And they did it. I mean I find that the level is much higher there because I mean that’s why it was a smaller family, because not everybody can reach those levels and there were a lot of giants walking the earth then. [Inaudible]
